title: Level 5 (World Class) - B-27
notes:
West leads the ♦Q against 7♠. West's opening diamond lead should be won in the South hand. Dummy entries should be conserved as South's plan should be to try to learn West's shape.

If it turns out that West has a singleton heart, South will need that heart to be the ♥6 or ♥8. Several dummy entries will be needed to pick up the hearts. South should play a club to the ♣A and play a second club, ruffing. South crosses in trumps. North's last club is played and ruffed with the ♠A. South crosses again in trumps.

West has followed to 2 rounds of spades and 3 rounds of clubs. The ♦A confirms that West has 7 diamonds. The only hope is that his thirteenth card is the ♥6 or ♥8. The ♥9 is played, covered by East, and won by South. The appearance of the ♥8 from West is good news. North has 2 entries (a diamond ruff and a spade) to take 2 more finesses in hearts.
